units.source_text: 源氏公子听了这话有些不高兴，但看出这人是头中将，不觉失笑。

en.t: Prince Genji was somewhat displeased when he heard this, but when he saw that the person was the Captain Secretary, he could not help laughing.

units.source_text: 讨厌地回答道：“你这把戏倒是别人所想不到的。

en.t: He replied with annoyance, "This trick of yours is certainly something no one else would have thought of."
